verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a setting or policy that keeps a user's Gmail data out of AI model training. Community reports describe switching off Gemini and Smart Features (gmail-comm-14, gmail-comm-16). That is an adjacent control over AI feature usage, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
